$comment: Z05: a fillable decision sheet for the 76 negative-amount WBS rows. It contains NO real
transaction data and must never be committed with any. Every row identifies its subject by a
stable hash, not by amount, vendor or description.
Why this exists: H09 found 76 negative rows totalling -24,343,397.24, of which 11 are below
-1,000,000. Whether a negative source amount means a payment/reversal or a payable accrual is
an ACCOUNTING POLICY judgement, not something the system can infer. Until an Owner decides, no
row in this set may be drafted or posted.
Fill one entry per source_category. Do not fill decided_meaning yourself unless you are the

population_summary.$comment: Aggregates only, carried over from H09. No row-level data.
population_summary.source: H09 exception-queue analysis; not re-measured by this template

decision_options.$comment: The closed set of meanings a negative source amount may be assigned. Each states its own ledger effect so the consequence is explicit before the choice is made.

PAYMENT_OR_SETTLEMENT.meaning: The row records cash leaving against an existing payable.
PAYMENT_OR_SETTLEMENT.ledger_effect: Dr AP control (291001) / Cr cash. Reduces the open payable.
PAYMENT_OR_SETTLEMENT.requires: A matching posted payable and a bank member.

REVERSAL_OF_PRIOR_ACCRUAL.meaning: The row reverses an earlier accrual booked in error or superseded.
REVERSAL_OF_PRIOR_ACCRUAL.ledger_effect: Mirror of the original entry. Must name the original.

CREDIT_NOTE_FROM_VENDOR.ledger_effect: AP_VENDOR_CREDIT adjustment; reduces open balance via allocation.

NEGATIVE_PAYABLE_ACCRUAL.meaning: The source genuinely expresses a negative accrual (a debit-side payable).
NEGATIVE_PAYABLE_ACCRUAL.ledger_effect: Dr expense / Cr AP with a negative sign, i.e. a contra-accrual.
NEGATIVE_PAYABLE_ACCRUAL.requires: Explicit Owner confirmation; this is the least common reading and the easiest to get wrong.

SOURCE_DATA_ERROR.meaning: The sign is wrong at source.
SOURCE_DATA_ERROR.ledger_effect: None. The row goes to the exception queue and is not drafted.
SOURCE_DATA_ERROR.requires: A WBS-side correction; REFS must not silently flip the sign.

UNDECIDED.meaning: Default. No decision has been made.
UNDECIDED.requires: Nothing. This is the only legal starting value.

entries.$comment: TEMPLATE ROW — copy per source_category, do not fill with real data in this file.
entries.stable_id_hash: <sha256:... of the source record identity; never the raw identity>
entries.risk: <CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW  — per the X03 rule: any negative is at least HIGH>
entries.candidate_meaning: <one key from decision_options, proposed by the preparer>
entries.candidate_rationale: <why the preparer proposes it; evidence reference, not transaction detail>
entries.decision_reason: <8-2000 chars, required once decided_meaning leaves UNDECIDED>
entries.exception: <if the row cannot be decided: why, and what input is missing>
